scriptList.Name: Read_pos.script
scriptList.Content:
#関数から現在のポイントを取得し、actposへ値を入れる
actpos=cc_client.sendAndRecv('ReadActPos,0,;')

J1=float(actpos[2]) #2~7は各軸座標を取得
J2=float(actpos[3])
J3=float(actpos[4])
J4=float(actpos[5])
J5=float(actpos[6])
J6=float(actpos[7])

#ローカル変数→グローバル変数へ変換
cc_client.sendVarValue('J1',J1)
cc_client.sendVarValue('J2',J2)
cc_client.sendVarValue('J3',J3)
cc_client.sendVarValue('J4',J4)
cc_client.sendVarValue('J5',J5)
cc_client.sendVarValue('J6',J6)

x=float(actpos[8]) #8~13はベース座標を取得
y=float(actpos[9])
z=float(actpos[10])
rx=float(actpos[11])
ry=float(actpos[12])
rz=float(actpos[13])

#ローカル変数→グローバル変数へ変換
cc_client.sendVarValue('x',x)
cc_client.sendVarValue('y',y)
cc_client.sendVarValue('z',z)
cc_client.sendVarValue('rx',rx)
cc_client.sendVarValue('ry',ry)
cc_client.sendVarValue('rz',rz)

#ローカル変数→Modbus保持デバイスへ(整数値)
cc_client.setModbus('Modbus_1','D1010',x)
cc_client.setModbus('Modbus_1','D1012',y)
cc_client.setModbus('Modbus_1','D1014',z)
cc_client.setModbus('Modbus_1','D1016',rx)
cc_client.setModbus('Modbus_1','D1018',ry)
cc_client.setModbus('Modbus_1','D1020',rz)

cc_client.Write_Register_Float('Modbus_1','D1010',x)

scriptList.Name: test.script
scriptList.Content:
import time

file_path = '/usr/local/RobotOS/home/RobotOS/HRCPS/script/CCClient.py'

cc_client.socket_open('192.168.1.59',5000,'test')

try:

    with open(file_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        #count = 0
        for line in f:
            #count += 1
            #if count < 726:
            #    continue
            
            cc_client.socket_send_string(line,'test')
        
    time.sleep(10)
    cc_client.socket_close('test')

except FileNotFoundError:
    str_1 = 'not found'
    cc_client.sendVarValue('str_1', str_1)
except Exception as e:
    str_1 = f"Error: {e}"
    cc_client.sendVarValue('str_1', str_1)
